title.narrative: Health Modernization and Humanization Program
Programa de Modernizacin y Humanizacin de la Salud

description.narrative: El objetivo del Programa de es contribuir a la mejora de las condiciones de salud de la poblacin del Municipio de So Bernardo do Campo (MSBC), por medio del fortalecimiento del sistema de salud municipal con nfasis en la expansin y reorganizacin de la atencin bsica a la salud. Los objetivos especficos del Programa consisten en: (i) fortalecer la capacidad de gestin de la Secretaria de Salud (SS) del MSBC; y (ii) fortalecer la red municipal de servicios de atencin bsica de salud.

The goal of the Program is to contribute to the improvement of the health status of the population of the Municipality of So Bernardo do Campo (MSBC), by means of strengthening the municipal health system, with emphasis on the expansion and reorganization of primary health care. The specific goals of the Program are: (i) strengthening management capacity of the Health Department of MSBC; reorganization of the municipal network of primary health care services.
